description: The bar chart illustrates the module Giga FLOPs for different audio back-end modules across three stages of a speech recognition system. The vertical axis represents the module Giga FLOPs, ranging from 0 to 0.3, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into three stages: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125). Each stage is represented by a group of four bars, each corresponding to a different type of attention mechanism: attention (blue), grouped attention (g=3) (red), patch attention (k=3) (yellow), and feed-forward (green). In Stage 1, the attention mechanism has the highest FLOPs, approximately 0.3, while the feed-forward mechanism has the lowest, around 0.1. In Stage 2, the attention mechanism's FLOPs are slightly lower than in Stage 1, around 0.2, and the feed-forward mechanism's FLOPs are slightly higher, around 0.1. In Stage 3, the attention mechanism's FLOPs are the lowest, around 0.1, and the feed-forward mechanism's FLOPs are the highest, around 0.1. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
